raw: #1: = ♦ Isa. xiii. 10. ¦ † Ezek. xxxii. 7. ¦ ‡ Dan. viii. 10. ¦ § Whether it bear directly on the illustration of this language or not, it is worthy of remark, that the meteors called "falling stars," eclipses, and other striking appearances in the sky, were thought, by the common people, to be omens of calamity. See Virg. Georg. i. 365, and 462. *Statius, lib.* x, near the beginning.
